strings.tip.warm: Gafemarayɔrɔw ni sigida sow b'a to i ka sigi, ka telefɔni sarzi, ka taa ɲɛgɛn na, i mago tɛ ka foyi san. Su nɛnɛbaw la, duguw bɛ sunɔgɔyɔrɔ wɛrɛw dayɛlɛ: sosiyal baarakɛla ɲininka walima sosiyal teliyako nimɔrɔ wele.
strings.tip.water: Tuma o tuma i tɛmɛna ji-bɔyɔrɔ la, i ka buteli fa minji la: nata bɛ se ka jan walima a jalen don. Tilema la, ji min sani minnɔgɔ k'i minɛ.
strings.tip.health: Teliyako la, taa dɔgɔtɔrɔso o dɔgɔtɔrɔso: u ka kan k'i lajɛ, sɛbɛn b'i bolo wo, a t'i bolo wo. A tɔ kama, nin dɔgɔtɔrɔsow bɛ asiransitanw lajɛ; i bɛ fura minnu ta ka ban, olu ta ka na.
strings.tip.social: Sosiyal baarakɛla bɛ se ka daw dayɛlɛ nin karti tɛ se ka minnu dayɛlɛ: teliyako sigiyɔrɔ, dumuni karti, dɔgɔtɔrɔ hali sɛbɛn t'i bolo. Don ka i mago fɔ; rendevu mago tɛ walasa ka ɲininkali kɛ.
strings.tip.clothes: Dɛmɛ butikiw bɛ finiw di fu walima sɔngɔ fitinin na, n'i y'i ka ko ɲɛfɔ u ye. Sanbara ni manto ɲini fɔlɔ: olu de bɛ ban joona.
strings.tip.hygiene: N'i bɛ se, i yɛrɛ ka sɛrifɛti ta ka na; yɔrɔ caman bɛ safinɛ singa. Ɲɛgɛn minnu sɛbɛnnen don ko u ye fu ye yan, olu tɛ wari ta.
strings.tip.shelter: Sunɔgɔyɔrɔ fanba bɛ dilanw tila wulafɛ, u bɛ da datugu su fɛ. Wele sani i ka taa yen, ni dilan tɛ yen, u ɲininka i bɛ se ka taa yɔrɔ wɛrɛ min na: u b'o dɔn.

strings.hero.lede: SupportNear bɛ karti kelen kan k'a jira i la, i bɛ dumuni goniman, dilan bi su, ko ji goniman, fini saniyalen, kɛnɛya dɛmɛ ani sariya ladili fu sɔrɔ yɔrɔ min na — ka daminɛ i lɔlen bɛ yɔrɔ min na sisan.

strings.how.s1p: Imɛli tɛ, tɔgɔ gundo tɛ, fɔrimilɛri tɛ. Digi siɲɛ kelen k'i yɔrɔ jira, walima dugu, sira walima gari tɔgɔ sɛbɛn.
strings.how.s2p: Dumuni, dilan, ko yɔrɔ, finiw, dɔgɔtɔrɔsow, minji ani sariya dɛmɛ bɛ jira karti kan, ka labɛn i ka taama janya ma.
strings.how.s3p: Waatiw, telefɔni nimɔrɔ ani sen na taasira, digili kelen na. Ni yɔrɔ dɔ datugulen don, an bɛ tɔ gɛrɛnen jira i la min dayɛlɛlen don.
strings.what.h2: Dɛmɛ suguya seegin, karti kelen kan.
strings.what.p: Yɔrɔ bɛɛ bɛ bɔ OpenStreetMap la, diɲɛ ka karti dayɛlɛlen min bɛ mara dɛmɛbaga ba caman, mɛriw ani dɛmɛ tɔnw fɛ. A ye foroba ta ye, a ye fu ye, ani mɔgɔ o mɔgɔ bɛ se k'a latilen — i yɛrɛ fana.
strings.im.s1: diɲɛ mɔgɔw tɛ se ka dɛmɛ jɔnjɔnw sɔrɔ minnu ye u ta ye sariya la, katuguni mɔgɔ si m'a fɔ u ye o dɛmɛw bɛ yɔrɔ min na.
strings.im.s2: sigida dɛmɛsow, sunɔgɔyɔrɔw, dumuni bankiw ani ko yɔrɔw sɛbɛnnen don OpenStreetMap kan ka ban, u bɛ sɔrɔ SupportNear fɛ.
strings.im.s4: ka bɔ ɲɛ dayɛlɛli la fo ka da dayɛlɛlen gɛrɛnen ye, ni 3G ye ani telefɔni min si ye san wɔɔrɔ ye.
strings.orgs.p1: Duguw bɛ wari bɔ sunɔgɔyɔrɔw kan minnu tilancɛ lakolon don, k'a sɔrɔ mɔgɔw bɛ sunɔgɔ sira saba dɔrɔn kɔ. Dumuni bankiw bɛ dumuni fili, k'a sɔrɔ denbayaw bɛ kɔngɔ la. Gɛlɛya tɛ wari ye tuma caman na — kunnafoni de tɛ se mɔgɔ ma min mago b'a la, a bɛ kan min kalan, waati min na a mago b'a la.
strings.orgs.p2: SupportNear bɛ o dan tugu ni foroba kunnafoni dayɛlɛlenw ye. Fɛn si tɛ yen ka bila, kontara tɛ, lisansi sarali tɛ mɔgɔ kelen-kelen kan. Ni aw ka dɛmɛ bɛ OpenStreetMap kan, a bɛ yan ka ban. N'a tɛ yen, an bɛna aw dɛmɛ k'a bila yen wulafɛ kelen kɔnɔ — o kɔ, a bɛna bɔ aplikasiyɔn tɔw bɛɛ la fana minnu bɛ baara kɛ ni o karti dayɛlɛlen kelen ye.
strings.orgs.cta2: Wari di walima jɛ ni an ye

strings.foot.tag: Porozɛ min tɛ tɔnɔ ɲini. Dɛmɛ fu, mɔgɔ o mɔgɔ bɛ se k'a sɔrɔ yɔrɔ o yɔrɔ — kɔnti tɛ, nɔminɛ tɛ.
strings.far.p: OpenStreetMap ma foyi caman sɛbɛn yan fɔlɔ. An bɛ yɔrɔ min dɔn min ka surun, o bɛ {d} la. Dugu dɔ filɛ min ka surun, walima i bɛ yɔrɔ min dɔn, o fara a kan walasa mɔgɔ nata k'a sɔrɔ:

strings.now.p: Dilan fɔlɔ, o kɔ dumuni, o kɔ ko yɔrɔ. An b'a dɔn ko yɔrɔ minnu datugulen don, olu dogolen don. Wele sani i ka taa sen na: sunɔgɔyɔrɔ caman b'a fɛ i ka yɔrɔ ta fɔlɔ.

strings.tip.legal.p: Jamana caman na, sariya dɛmɛ fu bɛ ɲini avokaw ka tɔn fɛ (avocat commis d'office), walima meri ka sigida dɛmɛso fɛ, a tɛ sɔrɔ yɔrɔ min na i bɛ se ka don dɔrɔn. Sira min ka teli: taa Sigida dɛmɛ yɔrɔ dɔ la nin karti kan, k'u ɲini u k'i ci. U b'o kɛ don o don.
strings.cat.health.d: Dɔgɔtɔrɔsow, furakɛli sɔngɔ dɔgɔmanw, farati dɔgɔyali ani teliyako dɔgɔtɔrɔsow.

strings.cat.warm.d: Gafemarayɔrɔw, sigida sow ani foroba yɔrɔw, i bɛ se ka sigi yɔrɔ minnu na, ka telefɔni sarzi, ka nɛnɛ bɔ i la.
strings.faq.a2: Abada. Kɔnti tɛ, fɔrimilɛri tɛ. Karti bɛ dayɛlɛ o yɔrɔnin bɛɛ. An t'a dɔn i ye jɔn ye, wa an y'a dilan cogo min na, an tɛ se k'a dɔn.
strings.faq.a3: I bɛ yɔrɔ jɔnjɔn min na, o bɛ to i ka telefɔni kɔnɔ. Walasa ka yɔrɔw sɔrɔ i lamini, an bɛ ɲinini mara dɔrɔn ci OpenStreetMap ka foroba sɛrivɛriw ma, a tɛ jɔnjɔn ye — karti app bɛɛ bɛ ɲininkali kelen in kɛ. Foyi tɛ mara, wa foyi tɛ siri i la.
strings.faq.a4: OpenStreetMap fɛ, diɲɛ karti dayɛlɛlen. Fu baarakɛlaw (bénévoles), meriw, dɛmɛ tɔnw ani adamadenya dɛmɛ kuluw de b'a ladon. O de kosɔn a ka ɲi kosɛbɛ dugu dɔw la, wa a ka dɔgɔ dɔ wɛrɛw la — wa o de kosɔn mɔgɔ o mɔgɔ, hali e, bɛ se ka yɔrɔ min tɛ a kan, o fara a kan miniti dama kɔnɔ.
strings.faq.q5: Yɔrɔ dɔ min bɛ karti kan, o datugulen tun don walima a tun tɛ yen tugun. N ka kan ka mun kɛ?
strings.faq.q6: N bɛ baara kɛ sunɔgɔyɔrɔ / dumuni banki / dɔgɔtɔrɔso dɔ la. An bɛ don karti kan cogo di?
strings.faq.a6: A bɛ se ka kɛ ko aw bɛ yen ka ban. N'a tɛ o ye, aw ka sɛbɛn partners@supportnear.com ma, an bɛ aw ka baara bila karti kan n'aw ye, fu, ka a jira aw la aw yɛrɛ bɛ se k'a kuraya cogo min na.
strings.faq.a7: I mago bɛ kɔnɛkisɔn na walasa ka yɔrɔ kuraw ta, nka ni rezo tununna, i ye jaabi laban minnu ye, olu bɛ to yen. Sani i ka taa, i bɛ taa yɔrɔ min na, o adɛrɛsi ja ta (capture d'écran).
strings.faq.a8: SupportNear bɛ taa ɲɛ i n'a fɔ porozɛ min tɛ tɔnɔ ɲini. An y'a dilan ni hakili ye walasa a baarali sɔngɔ ka dɔgɔ — sɛrivɛri tɛ minnu falen bɛ mɔgɔw ka kunnafoni gundolenw na, piblisite tɛ, feereli kulu tɛ. Jamana ka dɛmɛ waridiw (subventions), fondasionw ani mɔgɔw ka bolomafaraw de b'a sara, wa a tɛna sara abada ni mɔgɔ minnu b'a baara, olu ka kunnafoniw feereli ye.
strings.priv.2:
• Kɔnti tɛ, abada. Tɔgɔ tɛ, imɛli tɛ, telefɔni nimɔrɔ tɛ, pyɛsi tɛ.
  • Cookies tɛ, nɔminɛ tɛ. An bɛ jate kɛ tɔgɔ kɔfɔbali dɔrɔn: lajɛli kelen, kan, dugu ani min ɲininna nka a ma sɔrɔ. Adɛrɛsi IP tɛ, i ka minɛn taamasyɛn tɛ, foyi tɛ min b'a fɔ i ye jɔn ye; wa foyi tɛ, n'i ka navigatɛri b'a ɲini ko a kana tugu i kɔ.
  • I ka GPS yɔrɔ bɛ to i ka minɛn kan. A bɛ baara i ka navigatɛri kɔnɔ walasa ka jaabiw labɛn ka da u janya kan.
  • Ɲinini mara dɔrɔn. Walasa ka yɔrɔw sɔrɔ, an bɛ OpenStreetMap ka foroba sɛrivɛriw ɲininka mara dɔ kan, a tɛ i kan. O sɛrivɛriw bɛ ɲininkali dɔ ye min bɔra navigatɛri tɔgɔbali dɔ la, i n'a fɔ karti wɛrɛ o karti.
  • Foyi tɛ mara an fɛ. I ka jaabi labanw bɛ mara i yɛrɛ ka navigatɛri kɔnɔ walasa app ka baara kɛ hali ni rezo tununna. N'i ye i ka navigatɛri ka kunnafoniw jɔsi, olu bɛ tunun.
strings.priv.3: Ni i bɛ ko dɔ kɔnɔ, nɔminɛ ye farati ye i ma yɔrɔ min na — i bɛ bori fariyakow ɲɛ, walima sɛbɛn t'i bolo — i bɛ se ka SupportNear baara k'a sɔrɔ i ma i ka yɔrɔ sira di a ma: o nɔ na, sira walima tɛrɛnso dɔ tɔgɔ sɛbɛn min ka surun, ani navigatɛri finɛtiri gundolen (navigation privée) kɛ.

notes: Critical: how.s2p rendered "drinking water" as "ji nɔgɔlen" (dirty water) - now "minji" everywhere. "Emergency" was "kɔrɔbɔli" (= test/trial) - now "teliyako". "nearest" was "nafolo" (= wealth); "public" was "jamana" (= country) - now "foroba"; toilets were "kabakurun" (= stone) - now "ɲɛgɛn"; "public transport" was "bololabaara" (= handwork); homeless "Sojugutigiw" -> "Sotanw"; far.p said "the nearest place we do NOT know"; far.add said "a place that knows me"; tip shelters "malolabaga". Unified terms: karti (map; was kata/kartu/mapu/kariti), fu (free; was gansan), dayɛlɛ/dayɛlɛlen (open; was da wuli/dayɛlɛnen), rezo (signal; was siginɛ/risoli), kɔnti (account), kɔnɛkisɔn, ko yɔrɔ (shower), fini (clothes), adɛrɛsi (address; was sigiyɔrɔ = home), dumuni banki. Replaced leftover French (Paramètres, Annuler, Mode kiosque, télécharger, Boussole, Flèche, navigateur, serveur, Compte, formulaire). Fixed past tense "marana" -> "marala", numeral order "miniti {m}", "segin" -> "seegin" (eight), now.p missing sentences, plurals filled for "other".
